subject: NUMVAL-F function
notes: Leading, trailing and embedded spaces are ignored wherever the §15.69.3 r1 figure admits one: the value is a projection of the ONE positional NvfScan (NumvalFDec), the same scan TEST-NUMVAL-F reads, which skips them and never joins the runs on either side, so inserting or removing them never changes the value. That holds on the alphanumeric and the national path alike, and in every channel, because the value is the same exact parse whatever receiver, mode or channel reads it (kb/Work PB3839). The deliberate split from AR-15.69.3-5 stands: r1 tells you how to VALUE a conforming argument, it does not license ACCEPTING a non-conforming one, and §15.3 makes the argument-rule violation a separate obligation.
